تزدرون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرُونَ (tazdarūna) /taz.da.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# تُزْدَرَوْنَ (tuzdarawna) /tuz.da.raw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
